verdict.rationale: Convex offers a CLI `import` command for bulk-loading data into a deployment, which is the only documented bulk-operation-style capability; there is no evidence of a general batch mutation/query API for acting on many existing items at once (e.g., bulk update/delete across queries) or of the MCP server exposing such bulk tools to AI agents. Missing for 10: documented batch mutation/delete API, evidence of MCP/agent tools performing multi-item bulk edits, and independent confirmation of bulk operation performance/limits.
